decisions.reason: As an adjacent extension with its own product page still maintained in 2024, it looks like a low-cost option in the core range whose value has not turned negative.
This articulated dumper remains prominently marketed and fits the established construction portfolio, so management would likely keep the option open unless clearer weak demand appears.
Because it is distant from the core offer and was downgraded from a dedicated page to a mere mention without positive results, the evidence points to limited promise relative to its support cost.
The telescopic loader is close to existing capabilities and still receives full standalone presentation, suggesting acceptable traction and low enough continuation cost to retain it.
The reported major order is a strong early signal of market acceptance for a product close to the firm's established lifting business, so there is little reason to abandon it now.

Although technologically and commercially more distant from the core range, the strong seven-month utilization data indicate promising value, so the firm would likely continue rather than cut the option prematurely.
